versions.name: Camp Ross
versions.address: 340 Millard Burke Memorial Highway Goshen, Virginia 22439

features.note: Handicraft area offering tie-dye and leatherwork.
Nature area with critter study and Leave No Trace sessions.
The Phoenix Nest option forms one pack from small parties of one adult and up to four youth.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/082-101976); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
